title: Chapter 899
paragraphs: Chapter 899
Episode 226. The World of Rokia
Two people were looking at the glass tubes in front of them in a machine room filled with all sorts of massive magic circles on the floor, walls, and ceiling.
They were Ran and Mu. Just like Ann, they were in the same appearance as their days as Rune-Kendel Riders, except that they were wearing black robes instead of rider coats.
They noticed one of the five tubes glowing red. Ann was in that tube, and the red light signified that she had lost her physical form in the human world.
"...Could it really have happened so quickly? It's been less than an hour since she arrived from the underworld to the human world."
At Ran's words, Mu shrugged his shoulders.

"Indeed, big sister has become much colder than we thought. Or, someone else, perhaps Jin or the former Black Knights, came to support them and she was defeated by them. Either way, she was unlucky. Let's ask her for the details when she wakes up."
It would take at least a month for Ann to regain consciousness and emerge from the glass tube.

They inspected the three empty glass tubes and the machinery room. They carefully checked the glass tubes to see if there were any cracks and infused more magical power into the faded magic circles drawn all over the place.

As soon as they finished their work and left the machine room, they headed towards the nearest teleportation gate. In the human world, it was the Hufes Tower central teleportation gate, which had been closed since the Sword Emperor Temple.
The gatekeeper at the teleportation gate bowed his head in fear as the siblings approached.
"Welcome, the new... you're the Administrators."
Administrators, that's what they were called in this world. Everyone living here feared the Administrators more than any powerful force.
"Where may I direct you?"
"The Creator's Space."
"I will prepare immediately!"

Long ago, Rokia created this world and named Ganesto's dwelling as the Creator's Space. Rokia had many aliases a thousand years ago, and 'Creator' was the term the Saints often used to refer to her during the Ten Great Knights era.
"Just a thought."
Mu opened his mouth as they stepped into the VIP seat.
"The House of Ganesto named this place after your title from the time you were a Ten Great Knight."
"And why is that?"
"I was wondering if you might have some lingering sentiment from that era."
The teleportation gate reached its destination in an instant. The Creator's Space was, except for its name and location, a landscape identical to the Garden of the Sword a thousand years ago.

"Have you asked that even though you've been looking at this place every day since you left the solitary fortress? Of course, there must be some remnants. You've missed the ideal right in front of your eyes."
"Well, that's true."
However, the Creator's Space was devoid of people, filled with a desolate atmosphere.
The garden had far fewer swords than the real Garden of Swords in the human world and the Garden of Swords here in Kalon, and no one was passing by.

The only ones who used this vast garden were the Ganestos. There were no servants, no stewards and gatekeepers, no knights, no one. The only sound was the chirping of the grass insects, which kept it from feeling too creepy.
The two moved towards the training room where Joshua could be.
In the middle of the training room, Joshua was, as always, sitting in meditation. Meditation is what he has done the most since awakening the blood of Ganesto.
"First Rider."
Joshua and those rescued from hell also became riders in Ganesto. First Rider Joshua, Second Rider Ran, Third Rider Vugo, Fourth Rider Mu, Fifth Rider Ann.
Among them, only Vugo hadn't yet completed his awakening. Therefore, Vugo had never been to the Creator's Space.
"You've arrived."
"Ann has lost her physical body in the human world. She won't wake up for at least a month."
"That was bound to happen. It's not a problem if Ann couldn't hold on longer than expected."
"Should we report to the landlord as well?"
"No, I will tell Mother."
Joshua, unlike the other Ganesto Riders, called Rokia "Mother". The riders thought the reason was that Joshua had the deepest awakening. Because his bond with Rokia would be deep.
"Understood."
"Has there been any error?"
The world created by Rokia is unstable.
Although the overall history of this place follows the will of its creator, Rokia, there have been many cases where problems she did not want occurred.

A strong character who can change the world's geography suddenly appears, causing a crack in the power structure, or an unforeseen natural disaster occurs, destroying places that should not be destroyed, etc.

What the Administrators do is correct these errors. If a threat to the world emerges, they eliminate it, rebuild any necessary buildings that have collapsed, and remove anything that should not exist.
Ideally, it proceeds without anyone knowing, but there were not a few moments when the process had to be exposed to the saints. That was the reason everyone feared the administrators.
Fundamentally, creating a 'error-free' world is one of Rokia's long-standing desires.

"There's no confirmed serious error yet, but Serial Ziphil seems to have become somewhat violent. Unlike usual, he assassinated a few figures who did not support him at the Lutero Federation Conference."

"The dead were either the lords of small and medium-sized families with little influence or riders. So, it won't be a problem right now, but we've marked Serial Ziphil as a subject of caution for now."
"Serial Ziphil... In the human world, he is a figure of around Veradin Ziphil. Okay, if it seems like it will escalate into an error, report to me before dealing with it."
"Understood."
"Mu."
"Yes, First Rider."
"Is your physical body still in the Demon World?"
"Yes. It's well hidden in the deserted salt marsh. My physical body in the human world is also in perfect condition."

"Go to the Solitary Fortress in the Demon World. Inform Duke Kelliac about what happened to Ann. Dru Killat must have fled to Grosh Fortress after seeing the situation, but it will be hard to report the situation to Ragal due to Sakiel's eyes. As Duke Kelliac speculated, it seems that Biseps has joined hands with Runkandel."

"Whether it was in the past or now, our youngest has such good luck. After the war started, there was no information from the Demon World, which must have been a headache. Even if we do nothing, guys like Biseps find us themselves."
"That's not luck. It's closer to an inevitable result due to Jin's actions over time."

"The only place suitable for Biseps was the Barmel Alliance. Looking at Ann being in a glass case for a month, I made a twisted comment because things are complicated. We have a lot of things to do, but not enough hands to do them. If Rosa Runkandel, no, if Rosa Ganesto was here, it would have been a great help by now."
Joshua let out a soft laugh.
"If that was the case, you couldn't be as comfortable as you are now."
"If Rosa Runkandel treated us like she did in Runkandel's time even after fully awakening as a Ganesto, I would have seriously requested a purge from the Lord."

At those words, Joshua thought of the story of the Beast Temple he heard from Rokia. The conversation that Jin and the last remaining humanity of Rosa Runkandel, separated from the Beast at the time, had.

-"I stopped fighting because I was tired, because I no longer saw the way forward, or because I felt I had done enough. Becoming a Beast would have been a very easy path. Maybe... It would have been the most tempting and easiest path of all the ones I've taken to become a Beast since I was born.
-"I am on my way to repay the sins as a rider of the family. If you have any last words for the Beast, let me know."

-"Please... let death not be an easy escape. I hope that even in death, that disgusting soul and body will be trapped somewhere and suffer, that they will never be released from it no matter how much eternity passes, that I... will always be there... fervently. More than anything else... fervently..."
Rokia told Joshua that the curse that Rosa as a human had placed on the Beast did not come true.
The ego of the human Rosa Runcandel and the monster have been completely annihilated from this world. Annihilation that cannot ascend to hell or the path of reincarnation.
This is something that cannot be undone even by any immortal power left in the current Inse world.
"Rosa Runcandel has completely disappeared, so it's a meaningless conversation."
"But since the First Knight smiled, I think it was a great joke."
"I'm a person who often laughs, so it's not something to be proud of."
"What about our adorable little one, our beloved enemy! What about our youngest awakening the blood of Ganesto? Is it a possible story?"
Joshua had asked Lokia the same question as Mu.
"Jin, as the contractor of Soldieret, cannot awaken the blood of a Ganesto."
"I don't understand why our awakening is classified as a curse. Then, can the rest awaken someday?"
"That also depends on what we do in the future. If Mother's world becomes perfect and can replace Inse. All the brothers in the Barmel Union will be like that. Even Jin..."
Unlike other Ganestos, Joshua was not particularly interested in the awakening of Jin or other brothers.
He wanted to show his mother that they could do it without them. However, if possible, he wished Dr. Quaul would awaken at any opportunity.

Because Quaul has too great ability compared to the concentration of inherited blood, it continues to provide a huge yet beneficial variable to the Barmel Union. In Lokia's world, it is like a walking error lump.
"Let's stop pointless assumptions and jokes here. Lan, from today for a while, you will take care of the space of creation instead of me."
"Where are you going?"

"I'm going to Inse. It seems that Mother has finally found a clue about him. Lucy Runcandel, the last knight of a thousand years ago that Jin has never seen before. You made sure to check the glass tube?"
"Yes, I adjusted it perfectly."
Joshua got up from his seat.

"I'll leave right away. If an error that is difficult for you to handle occurs, report to Mother immediately. And just in case, don't talk about Lucy Runcandel when you meet Lord Kellick. He's got the dragons coveted by Shinu."
"Oh, are you joking? Do you still see me as Mu from the Runcandel era?"
Joshua chuckled again.
"Yeah, it's a joke."
"That's not funny. Please have a safe trip."
Heading to the engine room, Joshua thought about the identity of Lucy Runcandel.
'Shinu couldn't even control it, but it's enough to follow the fire dragons. The mother of all deprecated dragons... It's worth being cautious by Mother.'
